description: Read public TikTok data with Desearch. Set action and that action's arguments. search (query; optional count, sort, cursor): videos that match a keyword. post (id): one video by its ID. profile (username): one profile. profile_posts (username; optional count, cursor): a user's videos. comments (video_id; optional count, cursor): a video's comments. hashtag (tag; optional count, cursor): videos with a hashtag. trending (optional region, count): trending videos for a region, one page. A video id from search can be passed to post or comments. post and profile return the item itself. List actions return { results, next_cursor, next }. For the next page, call again with the same action and target and cursor set to next_cursor, unchanged; next_cursor is null on the last page. A cursor lasts 24 hours.

count.description: Most items to return (1-100). API default: 10 for search, 20 for the other list actions. One page may hold fewer.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same action and target, sent back unchanged. Omit it for the first page.

id.description: post: the TikTok video ID, example: '7620891413932166433'.

region.description: trending: two-letter region code, example: 'US' (API default).

sort.description: search: sort option, when TikTok supports one.

tag.description: hashtag: the hashtag without #, example: 'ai'. A leading # is removed.

username.description: profile, profile_posts: TikTok username, example: 'tiktok'. A leading @ is removed.

name: tiktok
title: TikTok
